death.note: The year 'two' refers to 802 AH (Rabīʿ al-Awwal being the 3rd month) based on al-Sakhāwī's biographical period. This information is cited by our shaykh (Ibn Ḥajar) in his 『Inbāʾ』.

person.note: エジプトで信奉されていた人々の一人。
Aḥmad b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Turkumānī。エジプトで信奉されていた人物の一人。802年ラビーʿ・アル＝アウワル月に死去したと、我らがシャイフ（イブン・ハジャル）がその『インバーア』で述べた。
Aḥmad b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Turkumānī, one of those who was held in high regard in Egypt. He died in Rabīʿ al-Awwal in the year 802, as our shaykh (Ibn Ḥajar) stated in his 『Inbāʾ』.
